exposure: Antibiotic regimen (third-generation Cephalosporins, Penicillin/b-lactam, or Linezolid)
cohort: 116 women with BMI 18-29 kg/m2 undergoing elective Cesarean Section for obstetric indications (malpresentation, placenta previa, recurrent CS).
finding: Preoperative prophylaxis with Penicillin/b-lactam was recommended as it minimally disrupted Lactobacilli and Bifidobacteria in colostrum compared to Cephalosporins and Linezolid, while effectively maintaining aseptic conditions.
